recommended_extension.stage: exploratory ARC task-label distillation, not confirmation of universal full-vocabulary gate generalization
recommended_extension.alternate_candidate: HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM3-3B; metadata screened only, not scheduled; same Smol family and larger size
recommended_extension.seed_policy: seed 42 is inherited budget/control choice, not a paper standard; no training SD reported for one run; question bootstrap conditional on each learned checkpoint does not estimate training-seed variability
recommended_extension.new_output_space: native-tokenizer logits of valid A..E labels, in the same semantic order per question; softmax over only K valid choices (K=3..5)
recommended_extension.proposed_loss: T^2 * (g * KL(p_teacher || p_student) + (1-g) * KL(p_student || p_teacher)); pure choice classification objective; original EOS CE not reused
recommended_extension.proposed_gate: confidence=1-H(p)/log(K); fixed g=.5; hard g=1[c_teacher>=c_student] detached; soft g=sigmoid(c_teacher-c_student-.05) with selection gradient
recommended_extension.hyperparameter_policy: T=2 and margin=.05 are inherited comparison settings with DSKD/CaRE context, not established optimum in the new label space; optimizer/LoRA/data/order/budget inherited within each model as declared controls; no tuning or paper replication claimed; finalize only after numerical/GPU validation
recommended_extension.evaluation_proposal: valid-choice argmax accuracy and choice NLL; gate weights and paired question CI; unconstrained generation only if later explicitly added, not interchangeable with this classifier evaluation
recommended_extension.comparison: fixed/hard/soft differences within each Student; rerun Qwen under the same new loss and evaluation instead of comparing old full-vocabulary results directly; different architectures/native prompts/LoRA counts preclude model-family causal superiority claims
recommended_extension.data: existing frozen ARC-Challenge train 1118 and validation 299; new test manifest required before new evaluations; existing Qwen/ARC test results have already been seen, so this extension is exploratory
recommended_extension.confirmation_policy: before any new test, commit the full model/method/seed matrix; any seed7/123 confirmation must repeat all three methods on the prespecified model(s), irrespective of a favorable or unfavorable outcome; do not select only positive test models
recommended_extension.cross_dataset_generalization: not established by adding a Student on the same ARC task; separate unseen task/data needed for that claim
